attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to strengthen the nation's public and private Historically Black Colleges and Universities, Predominantly Black Institutions, Hispanic-Serving Institutions, Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institutions, Tribal Colleges and Universities, Alaska Native and Native Hawaiian-Serving Institutions, Native American-Serving Nontribal Institutions, and minority-serving institutions.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many of these schools educate disproportionate percentages of growing populations of Americans: students who are racial and ethnic minorities, low-income students, and first-generation students.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The nation's HBCUs and Minority Serving Institutions have honed promising models for educating students to prepare them for high- and critical-need positions while containing costs.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to create a robust and historic dedicated fund to keep costs down, provide quality education, and ensure dedicated support to improve student outcomes and completion rates.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to provide further assistance to students at these schools, as well as other students across the country, by restoring year-round Pell funding so that low- and middle-income students from all backgrounds can get the support they need to make progress toward a college degree throughout the year.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
